title: License vehicles that carry dangerous goods in bulk
what: Use a road vehicle to carry dangerous goods in a receptacle over 500 litres, or over 500 kilograms in a receptacle, only if the vehicle is licensed.

laws.title: Dangerous Goods (Road and Rail Transport) Regulations 2021 (Tas)

sources.title: Dangerous Goods (Road and Rail Transport) Regulations 2021 (Tas)
sources.quote: A road vehicle must not be used to transport – (a) dangerous goods in a receptacle with a capacity of more than 500 litres; or (b) more than 500 kilograms of dangerous goods in a receptacle;

administration.who: Competent Authority under the dangerous goods transport law (Tas)

sources.title: Dangerous Goods (Road and Rail Transport) Regulations 2021 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 203, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: licensing authority means – (a) the Competent Authority appointed in respect of road transport;

reach.condition: if it carries dangerous goods in bulk (a receptacle over 500 L or 500 kg)

reach.condition: if it carries its own dangerous goods in bulk by road (such as fuel or chemicals)
